dish.n: Coorong shack black tea with honey
dish.note: Strong black tea with honey and milk, poured hot from the pot.
dish.how: Boil 1.2 litres of water, pour it over 6 black tea bags in a large teapot and steep for 4 minutes. Stir in 4 tbsp honey, pour into mugs and serve with 300ml of warm milk on the side.

steps.text: Boil the water and pour it over the tea bags in a large pot.
Steep for 4 minutes, stir in the honey and warm the milk.
Pour into mugs and serve with the milk on the side.
